item.title: Greenland says 'no thank you' after Trump says he is sending it a 'great hospital boat'
item.description: Trump said he was sending a "great hospital boat" to Greenland to care for its sick. Greenland, which has universal healthcare, said 'no thank you.'

item.title: I've been a product manager at one of China's biggest tech firms. Here's how Chinese AI products are built differently.
item.description: An AI product manager who worked at a Chinese tech giant explains what makes Chinese AI different from the West.

item.title: We wanted to get away from the cold, so we left Michigan and retired in Panama. We're not planning to move back.
item.description: Greg Kitzmiller was researching places to live with his wife and found out that Panama had a special visa for retirees.

item.title: We wanted to freeze time with our daughters. So we rented out our house and sent them to school in 3 countries in one year.
item.description: When Lisa Lucas and her husband told their kids about the plan to travel, the youngest daughter cried. They promised it would only be a year.

item.title: The 'Knight of the Seven Kingdoms' finale just blew up Dunk and Egg's biggest secrets
item.description: The season 1 finale of "A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms" implies that Dunk may not be a knight, and that Egg has been lying. Both are changes from the book.

item.title: Alpine skier Mikaela Shiffrin, 30, says she worked with a psychologist to 'desensitize' herself to the Olympics
item.description: Gold medalist Mikaela Shiffrin says she visited Paris two summers ago to get a feel for the Olympic atmosphere before this year's Games.

item.title: Drone maker Shield Al says putting bombs on everything isn't necessary if you know how to fight a modern war
item.description: While Shield AI is looking into weapons for the V-BAT, the world's best militaries already have a slew of other strike options, Brandon Tseng told BI.

item.title: Blizzard triggers New York City travel ban as airlines cancel thousands of flights
item.description: Airlines canceled thousands of flights across the Northeast on Sunday and Monday as a giant winter blizzard threatens to drop nearly two feet of snow.

item.title: You can't cop Jensen Huang's GPUs but you can eat the same cake he got for his birthday at work
item.description: Jensen Huang celebrated his 63rd birthday with a Paris Baguette cake you can buy at your local mall.

item.title: Tourists in Mexico's Puerto Vallarta told to shelter in place as cartel violence erupts
item.description: Violence erupted in Puerto Vallarta and other parts of Mexico after the government killed the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel.
